# Reporter gave no command line. -T cs_6_0 -E main follows from the shader's
# [numthreads] entry point. -HV 2021 is pinned because member `operator`
# declarations are an HLSL 2021 feature: it is today's default (so it changes
# nothing on main) but it makes every release in a sweep answer the same
# question, and makes pre-2021 releases say so explicitly.
-T cs_6_0 -E main -HV 2021 repro.hlsl
